name: splat_uncertainty
summary: Per-splat uncertainty from the training views: heatmaps and removal of uncertain splats.
description: Estimates how well the training photos constrain each splat with a block-diagonal Laplace approximation (Gauss-Newton Fisher information, as in PUP 3D-GS) over position, scale, rotation and opacity. Custom CUDA kernels render the training views and accumulate exact per-pixel Fisher blocks in seconds. Shows ten heatmap strategies, each labelled as paper-backed, derived or heuristic, and hides splats by uncertainty live with an undoable in-place removal. Requires an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12 (no CUDA toolkit needed) and a trained model with its dataset cameras; works while training is paused or finished. Pinhole cameras only for now. Tested on Windows.
author: dozeri
